headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 22, 2026**
article:
The Houston Astros secured a 4-2 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Christian Vázquez leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Spencer Arrighetti earned the win with 5 strong innings, striking out 5 and allowing 0 earned runs. The Cleveland Guardians also secured a win, defeating the Philadelphia Phillies 1-0 behind Gavin Williams' 8.0 innings of shutout baseball. The Tampa Bay Rays took down the New York Yankees 4-2, with Austin Wells leading the offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Mickey Moniak of the Colorado Rockies, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to right ankle tendonitis. Jung Hoo Lee of the San Francisco Giants has also been placed on the 10-day injured list with a mid-back strain. Other players on the injured list include Burch Smith of the Detroit Tigers, Ke'Bryan Hayes of the Cincinnati Reds, Yoán Moncada of the Los Angeles Angels, and Yusei Kikuchi of the Los Angeles Angels.

The Miami Marlins have acquired outfielder Rece Hinds in a trade with the Cincinnati Reds, sending right-handed pitcher Zach McCambley to the Reds in exchange. The Tampa Bay Rays also made a trade, acquiring third baseman Oliver Dunn from the Chicago White Sox in exchange for left-handed pitcher Joe Rock.
